question: Calculate the duration of each track, classify them as short, medium, or long, output the minimum and maximum time for each kind (in minutes) and the total revenue for each category, group by the category.
sql:
WITH stats AS (
  SELECT 
    MIN(Milliseconds / 60000.0) AS min_val,
    MAX(Milliseconds / 60000.0) AS max_val,
    AVG(Milliseconds / 60000.0) AS avg_val
  FROM Track
),
boundaries AS (
  SELECT 
    min_val,
    max_val,
    avg_val,
    (min_val + avg_val) / 2.0 AS short_boundary,
    (avg_val + max_val) / 2.0 AS medium_boundary
  FROM stats
),
track_with_duration AS (
  SELECT 
    t.TrackId,
    t.Milliseconds / 60000.0 AS duration_minutes,
    CASE 
      WHEN t.Milliseconds / 60000.0 <= b.short_boundary THEN 'short'
      WHEN t.Milliseconds / 60000.0 <= b.medium_boundary THEN 'medium'
      ELSE 'long'
    END AS category
  FROM Track t, boundaries b
),
revenue AS (
  SELECT 
    twd.category,
    SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) AS total_revenue
  FROM track_with_duration twd
  JOIN InvoiceLine il ON twd.TrackId = il.TrackId
  GROUP BY twd.category
),
min_max AS (
  SELECT 
    twd.category,
    MIN(twd.duration_minutes) AS min_duration,
    MAX(twd.duration_minutes) AS max_duration
  FROM track_with_duration twd
  GROUP BY twd.category
)
SELECT 
  mm.category,
  mm.min_duration,
  mm.max_duration,
  r.total_revenue
FROM min_max mm
JOIN revenue r ON mm.category = r.category
ORDER BY mm.category
